consequence.statement: Go code importing crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the go.mod module path and all import statements to the v2 module path when moving to v2+.
consequence.remediation: Update go.mod and all imports to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2.

assertion.statement: The Go module path changed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime/v2); Go consumers must update go.mod and all import statements.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure depends on whether the user's Go code imports crossplane or crossplane-runtime modules, which no static environment input (manifests, Helm values) carries.
